questions.prompt: Having followed the general, the soldiers feared the enemy's arrival.
questions.answer: Ducem secūtī, mīlitēs adventum hostium veritī sunt.

questions.prompt: We admire the words of the priest who bestows very many gifts.
questions.answer: Verba sacerdōtis quī plūrima dōna largītur mīrāmur.

questions.prompt: The queen, about to bestow rewards, encouraged those who had suffered many things.
questions.answer: Rēgīna, praemia largītūra, eōs quī multa passī erant hortāta est.

questions.prompt: You will follow your father, fearing the dangers of war.
questions.answer: Patrem sequēris, bellī perīcula verēns.

questions.prompt: The old man, wisdom having been attained, was not afraid of death.
questions.answer: Senex, sapientiā adeptā, mortem nōn verēbātur.

questions.prompt: Having set out at dawn, they followed the enemy's tracks through the woods.
questions.answer: Prīmā lūce profectī, vestīgia hostium per silvās secūtī sunt.

questions.prompt: I think that the leader will follow the fleeing enemy.
questions.answer: Putō ducem hostem fugientem secūtūrum esse.

questions.prompt: Let us encourage the young men who are bravely enduring hardships.
questions.answer: Hortēmur iuvenēs quī labōrēs fortiter patiuntur.

questions.prompt: The soldiers, about to die, spoke boldly to their commander.
questions.answer: Mīlitēs, moritūrī, audācter ad imperātōrem locūtī sunt.

questions.prompt: We follow the master's example, using few words.
questions.answer: Magistrī exemplum sequimur, paucīs verbīs ūtentēs.

questions.prompt: She feared that the enemy would follow her through the mountains.
questions.answer: Verita est nē hostis sē per montēs sequerētur.

questions.prompt: By admiring virtue, boys become good citizens.
questions.answer: Virtūtem mīrandō puerī bonī cīvēs fīunt.

questions.prompt: The general, having exhorted his men, ordered them to follow.
questions.answer: Dux, mīlitēs hortātus, eōs sequī iussit.

questions.prompt: We shall follow you into battle and endure all dangers.
questions.answer: Tē in proelium sequēmur et omnia perīcula patiēmur.

questions.prompt: The girl, using a gentle voice, consoled her weeping mother.
questions.answer: Puella, mollī vōce ūtēns, mātrem flentem cōnsōlāta est.

questions.prompt: Those about to follow the leader swore an oath.
questions.answer: Ducem secūtūrī iūs iūrandum iūrāvērunt.

questions.prompt: I do not fear those who threaten with words alone.
questions.answer: Nōn vereor eōs quī verbīs sōlīs minantur.

questions.prompt: While the enemy was delaying, our men crossed the river.
questions.answer: Dum hostis morātur, nostrī flūmen trānsiērunt.

questions.prompt: The consul promised that he would bestow rewards on the brave.
questions.answer: Cōnsul sē fortibus praemia largītūrum esse pollicitus est.

questions.prompt: Having spoken thus, the leader died in his father's arms.
questions.answer: Ita locūtus, dux in patris bracchiīs mortuus est.

questions.prompt: The laws which the ancestors established must be followed.
questions.answer: Lēgēs quās maiōrēs cōnstituērunt sequendae sunt.

questions.prompt: The soldiers, following the general, dared to attack the camp.
questions.answer: Mīlitēs, ducem secūtī, castra oppugnāre ausī sunt.
